> AURA is a custom 75% mechanical keyboard designed and built from the ground up for coding, typing, and gaming. It will feature Bluetooth connectivity, USB C, hot swappable switches, RGB lighting, a programmable rotary knob, media and lock controls, a rechargeable battery, and a solid, premium enclosure. The PCB, firmware, and enclosure will all be custom designed, making AURA fully understandable, repairable, and upgradeable rather than just another off the shelf keyboard.
